name: Corporate Action Option Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of CA options.

BSPL.name: Bonus Share Plan
BSPL.definition: Receive shares issued from the Share Premium Reserve of the company and considered as a capital distribution rather than a disbursement of income, with different tax implications (typically found in Australia).

BUYA.name: Buy Up
BUYA.definition: Buy additional securities to round up position.

CASE.name: Cash And Securities
CASE.definition: Election choice includes a combination of both cash and securities.

CEXC.name: Consent And Exchange
CEXC.definition: Vote to consent to change the terms of the securities agreement and to exchange securities.

CTEN.name: Consent And Tender
CTEN.definition: Vote to consent to change the terms of the securities agreement and to tender securities for cash.

CONN.name: Consent Denied
CONN.definition: Vote not to approve the event or proposal.

CONY.name: Consent Granted
CONY.definition: Vote to approve the event or proposal.

LAPS.name: Lapse
LAPS.definition: Allow event or entitled security to expire.

MPUT.name: Retain
MPUT.definition: An option that allows a holder to elect to retain their holding, eg, a putable bond.

NOAC.name: No Action
NOAC.definition: Option for the account owner not to take part in the event.

OFFR.name: Proposed Rate
OFFR.definition: In a remarketing of variable notes, the margin that shareholders can propose in respect of the next interest period.

OVER.name: Oversubscribe
OVER.definition: Subscribe to more equities than underlying securities position allows.

SPLI.name: Split Instruction
SPLI.definition: Option to give a split instruction, eg, a split voting instruction on a meeting.

NOQU.name: Non Qualified Investor
NOQU.definition: The account owner is a Non-Qualified Investor.

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Generic corporate action option to be used in case that no other specific code is appropriate.

QINV.name: Qualified Investor
QINV.definition: The account owner is a Qualified Investor.
